subpages.title: Petroleum Marketing Group Goes “All In” With Mako Networks, Standardizing Entire Retail Fuel Portfolio on Mako’s Secure, Cloud Managed Connectivity Platform - Mako Networks
subpages.desc: Mako Networks today announced another major expansion of its rapidly growing U.S. retail fuel footprint, as Petroleum Marketing Group (PMG) becomes the latest large scale operator to join Mako’s “All In” Program. Through this initiative, PMG will standardize all its eligible locations on Mako’s secure, cloud managed retail connectivity platform.
